block.expedition_rock_generator.controls: Empty hand: take output. Sneak-use: change redstone mode.
block.expedition_rock_generator.recipe.i: Place a lava source and the listed coolant beside the extruder. Put recipe bases directly below.
block.expedition_rock_generator.recipe.w: Water: Cobblestone. Add magma block for Stone, andesite alloy block for Andesite, or dripstone block for Limestone.
block.expedition_rock_generator.recipe.i: Blue ice: Blackstone, or Basalt above soul soil. Packed ice: Cobbled Deepslate, or Deepslate above magma.
block.expedition_rock_generator.recipe.m: Chocolate: Scoria. Molten clay: Seared Cobble. Basalt with magma fluid below: Scorched Stone.
block.expedition_rock_generator.recipe.s: Produces one block every 20 ticks, or every 10 ticks in Nether biomes. Use a hopper or other automation to collect the output.
